title: call.ringing
description: An inbound call is offered to this agent and has not been answered yet. The first entry of an inbound call's log.

CallRinging.description: An inbound call is offered to this agent and has not been answered yet. The first entry of an inbound call's log.

from.description: The calling number in E.164 form, or the web visitor id.

to.description: The number or route that was called.

run.description: The eval run that opened this call, when one did: such a call starts mid-conversation, in the golden's state. Absent or null for a person.

caller.description: Who this seems to be, from the number alone. Null when nobody is known.

external_id.description: The carrier or SIP call id, for tracing outside Pinecall.
